## 00:00 Google Cloud Introduction

**On-screen content:** The Google Cloud logo is displayed on a white background with a colorful bar at the bottom.
![Google Cloud logo](video-frame://14@00:00)

## 00:03 Discover a New Way to Process and Create Texts

**On-screen content:** A slide appears with the text "Descubra uma nova maneira de processar e criar textos" (Discover a new way to process and create texts). A YouTube subscribe button animation is visible in the top right corner.
![Slide: Discover a new way to process and create texts](video-frame://14@00:03)

## 00:09 Decodificando a nuvem | Processamento de linguagem natural

**On-screen content:** The title slide for the video is shown:
"<Decodificando a nuvem/> | Processamento de linguagem natural" (Decoding the cloud | Natural language processing).
![Title slide: Decoding the cloud | Natural language processing](video-frame://14@00:09)

## 00:11 What is Natural Language Processing (NLP)?

**On-screen content:** A slide defines NLP:
"O processamento de linguagem natural (PLN) é um ramo da inteligência artificial que utiliza o machine learning para processar e interpretar textos e dados." (Natural language processing (NLP) is a branch of artificial intelligence that uses machine learning to process and interpret texts and data.)
![Definition of Natural Language Processing (NLP)](video-frame://14@00:11)

## 00:17 Main Uses of NLP

**On-screen content:** A slide lists the main uses of NLP:
"Estes são os principais usos do PLN:
*   Conhecer a opinião dos clientes
*   Entender recibos e faturas
*   Analisar documentos e classificar conteúdo
*   Analisar tendências através de notícias e artigos online"
(These are the main uses of NLP:
*   Understand customer opinions
*   Understand receipts and invoices
*   Analyze documents and classify content
*   Analyze trends through news and online articles)
![List of main uses of NLP](video-frame://14@00:17)

## 00:24 Google Cloud's NLP Solutions

**On-screen content:** An animation shows a laptop and a magnifying glass, transitioning to a slide that states:
"O Google Cloud oferece diferentes soluções para que você monte o pacote de PLN mais adequado para a sua empresa." (Google Cloud offers different solutions for you to assemble the most suitable NLP package for your company.)
![Slide: Google Cloud's NLP solutions](video-frame://14@00:26)

## 00:32 API Natural Language

**On-screen content:** A slide describes API Natural Language:
"API Natural Language
Fornece modelos pré-treinados que permitem que os desenvolvedores trabalhem com recursos de compreensão da linguagem natural." (API Natural Language provides pre-trained models that allow developers to work with natural language understanding features.)
![Slide: API Natural Language description](video-frame://14@00:32)

## 00:38 AutoML Natural Language

**On-screen content:** A slide describes AutoML Natural Language:
"AutoML Natural Language
Permite que você crie e implemente modelos personalizados de machine learning para a linguagem natural." (AutoML Natural Language allows you to create and implement custom machine learning models for natural language.)
![Slide: AutoML Natural Language description](video-frame://14@00:38)

## 00:44 Dialogflow

**On-screen content:** A slide describes Dialogflow:
"Dialogflow
É um pacote de desenvolvimento completo para criar interfaces de conversação e implantá-las em qualquer website ou aplicativo." (Dialogflow is a complete development package for creating conversational interfaces and deploying them on any website or application.)
![Slide: Dialogflow description](video-frame://14@00:44)

## 00:50 Document AI

**On-screen content:** A slide describes Document AI:
"Document AI
É uma ferramenta para a leitura e interpretação de documentos e dados em escala." (Document AI is a tool for reading and interpreting documents and data at scale.)
![Slide: Document AI description](video-frame://14@00:50)

## 00:56 Analyze the Present and Step into the Future

**On-screen content:** A concluding slide with a robot character states:
"Analise o presente com as ferramentas de Machine Learning do Google Cloud e dê um passo a mais para o futuro." (Analyze the present with Google Cloud's Machine Learning tools and take a step further into the future.)
![Slide: Analyze the present with Google Cloud Machine Learning tools](video-frame://14@00:56)

## 01:03 Google Cloud Outro

**On-screen content:** The Google Cloud logo is displayed again, followed by a blank white screen.
![Google Cloud logo](video-frame://14@01:03)
